links.outcome: Concordance and performance of DeepSeek and ChatGPT o1 antibacterial regimens versus ID specialists' effective regimens
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 had the highest concordance with ID specialists, exceeding DeepSeek-R1 and ChatGPT o1. DeepSeek-R1, R1+WS, and ChatGPT o1 escalated to higher AWaRe tiers significantly more than ID specialists (P<0.005). DeepSeek was comparable to ChatGPT o1.
links.quote: Moreover, DeepSeek's antibacterial clinical decision-making is comparable to that of ChatGPT o1, with DeepSeek-V3 surpassing it in certain performance metrics.

links.outcome: Independent pharmacist review of AI antibacterial outputs against specialist regimens
links.effect: Five independent clinical pharmacists evaluated all outputs; DeepSeek-V3 had the highest overall ID specialists' endorsed rate, while R1 variants and ChatGPT o1 escalated to broader-spectrum tiers more than specialists.
links.quote: Then, Five independent clinical pharmacists evaluated all outputs.

unlisted_practices: Alignment of AI antibiotic recommendations with antimicrobial stewardship principles (WHO AWaRe classification)
Comparison of response latency and search success rate across LLMs

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM models (DeepSeek versions and ChatGPT o1) on retrospective clinical cases for antibacterial decision-making, benchmarked against ID specialists and actual regimens, without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
